content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an uninitialized pointer being passed to the `free` function when an error occurred during the initialization of the `rtr_mgr_config` structure. This situation arose if `group_len` was zero or if the `pthread_mutex_init` function failed, leading to the execution jumping to the error handling section before the `config->groups` pointer was properly initialized. The patch resolves this by validating `group_len` before allocating memory for `config->groups` and ensuring that the pointer is only freed if it has been initialized.
